newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile says cobalt sales still suspended.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile says cobalt sales still suspended.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center confirmed that cobalt sales will remain suspended until the Court of Federal Claims rules on the complaint filed by Minor Metals Inc.
A Stockpile official said a hearing was scheduled on May 15, but it was not clear if there will be a decision on that date.

On Tuesday a judge in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia dismissed a separate complaint by Minor Metals against Stockpile regarding the cobalt sale held in February this year.
The Stockpile official said in that case each party ended up paying its own costs.
